structured_output.what_is_happening: SPONGIEZ is a generic SpongeBob-themed pump.fun coin, about 36 minutes old. Its X link points to the official @SpongeBob brand handle and its website link points to SpongeBob's official Instagram, so neither belongs to the project. The chart shows a spike and a crash: GMGN's ATH price of 0.00158 is about $1.58M market cap, and the price is now about $0.00018 ($180-190k). Price is -88% over 5m (DexScreener) and -87% over 15m (GeckoTerminal), leaving it only +3% to +260% over 1h. Trading is very bot-heavy: about 5,600 buys came from only 295 unique buyers in the last hour. I found no organic social discussion. The only real SpongeBob events are older brand items: LEGO sets on Sept 1 and a McDonald's Happy Meal collab in mid-September.

narrative.description: SpongeBob nostalgia meme. It is an evergreen IP that has been cloned many times, with no specific new catalyst. The LEGO and McDonald's news is weeks old.
narrative.why_spreading: Nothing organic is visible. Activity looks like a short burst of bot and degen trading, followed by a dump of about 88% from the high.

structural_risks: Price is already down about 88% from a recent spike, so late buyers are trapped
